name: calc_get_overview
description: List open LibreOffice documents and Calc workbook metadata.

name: calc_get_range
description: Read values, formulas, number formats and a fingerprint; results over 5000 cells are truncated.

name: calc_set_range
description: Write values or formulas as one undo step with optional stale-write protection.

name: calc_import_csv
description: Import CSV text into EMPTY cells of a Calc sheet starting at start_cell, as one undo step. Every field is data, never a formula: text such as '=SUM(A1)' or '+1' stays text. typing 'text' (default) keeps every field as text; 'numbers' turns plain dot-decimal numbers (-12, 3.50, 1e3) into numbers and keeps leading-zero codes, decimal commas, percentages, currency, dates and booleans as text. Empty fields leave empty cells; short rows are padded. Refused before writing when the CSV is malformed, over 10000 cells or 1,000,000 characters, or any destination cell is not empty. Returns counts of text/number/empty cells as read back and 'verified'.

name: calc_sort_range
description: Sort the rows of a Calc range by one to three columns (sheet column letters inside the range), keeping every row together; has_header keeps the first row in place. LibreOffice order: ties keep their order; ascending puts numbers before text, descending text before numbers, and empty cells are last either way; case-insensitive unless case_sensitive. Formulas referring to their own row move with it; if sorting would change what any row shows (formulas referring to other rows), the sort is undone at once and returned with sorted:false. One undo step.

name: calc_filter_range
description: Filter a Calc range: hide the data rows that do not meet the conditions, changing no values (a standard filter; one per sheet). Operators: equals, not_equals (number or text), greater, greater_equal, less, less_equal (number), contains, not_contains, begins_with, ends_with (text), not_empty (no value; there is no 'empty' operator). match 'all' (default) or 'any'. An empty conditions list removes the filter. Returns visible and hidden row numbers as read back. One undo step.

name: calc_create_chart
description: Insert a chart of a Calc range: column, bar (horizontal), line, area, pie or scatter, with its top-left corner at anchor_cell and an optional title. By default the first row and first column of the range are labels and a legend is shown. Pass if_match (the fingerprint from calc_get_range) to refuse a source that changed. Refused before writing when the range holds no numbers. One undo step removes the chart; returns the chart as read back and 'verified'.

name: calc_list_charts
description: List the charts on a Calc sheet with name, type, title, source ranges, legend and position/size in centimetres (50 max). Read-only.

name: calc_get_rules
description: Read the rules on a Calc range: its conditional formats (operator, values, style), its data validation (taken from the range as a whole), whether the sheet is protected, and the sheet's frozen columns/rows (null when the document has several windows). Read-only.

name: calc_add_conditional_format
description: Add a conditional format to a Calc range: when a cell meets the condition it takes a built-in cell style (Good, Neutral, Bad, Warning, Error, Accent, Accent 1-3, Note). Operators: greater, greater_equal, less, less_equal, equal, not_equal (value1), between, not_between (value1 and value2) — values are numbers or text — or formula, with value1 an expression without '=' such as B2>C2 written for the range's top-left cell. Existing rules are kept. One undo step; returns the range's rules as read back.

name: calc_set_validation
description: Set data validation on a Calc range, replacing any there: type list (items, a dropdown of 1-100 entries), whole_number or decimal (operator between, not_between, greater, greater_equal, less, less_equal, equal with numeric value1/value2), or none to remove it. reject_invalid (default true) refuses other entries with error_message. Existing cell contents are not checked or changed. One undo step; returns the rule as read back.

name: calc_freeze_panes
description: Freeze the first columns and rows of a Calc sheet so they stay visible while scrolling (0 and 0 unfreezes). Applies to the named document's window, not whichever is in front, and is refused when that document has several windows. The window's current sheet is kept. Bridge undo step restores the previous freeze; returns the freeze as read back.

name: calc_protect_sheet
description: Protect (protect true) or unprotect a Calc sheet WITHOUT a password, so the user can lift it any time with Tools > Protect Sheet. Passwords are never accepted. A sheet the user protected with a password is never unprotected (changed:false with the reason). Protection stops edits of locked cells in the LibreOffice window; it does not stop this plugin's tools. Bridge undo step.

name: calc_insert_table
description: Turn a Calc range whose first row holds distinct column labels into a named table: a LibreOffice database range with filter buttons (filter_buttons, default true) and an optional built-in style (none by default; Default Style, Academic, Box List Blue/Green/Red/Yellow, Elegant, Financial, Simple Grid Columns, Simple Grid Rows, Simple List Shaded). name defaults to Table1, Table2... Refused when the range overlaps another table or a label is missing or repeated; if_match refuses a changed range. One undo step; returns the table as read back.

name: calc_activate_sheet
description: Show a sheet in the named Calc document's window (refused when the document has several windows). This changes only what the user sees, so there is nothing to undo; returns the previous sheet.

name: calc_recalculate
description: Recalculate the formulas of a Calc document: all (default) or only those LibreOffice marked as needing it (all: false). Use when automatic calculation is off, which the result reports. Only formula results change, from the current inputs, so there is no undo step.

name: calc_format_range
description: Apply the supported LibreOffice FormatSpec subset.

name: calc_clear_range
description: Clear contents and formats from a Calc range.

name: calc_create_sheet
description: Create a Calc sheet; duplicate names are rejected.

name: calc_execute_plan
description: Submit one bounded WorkbookPlan V1 exactly once (strict LibreOffice subset: reads read_range/summarize_range_stats; operations write_values, write_formula, format_range, create_sheet, plus the LibreOffice extension clear_range; verification range_values_equal, range_formulas_equal, range_number_format_equal, sheet_exists, sentinel_unchanged). The whole plan is validated before any change, executes as one undo step, and is never retried.

expected.description: Expected scalar value of the single sentinel cell.

name: writer_get_text
description: Read one page of a Writer document's body in order: up to 500 blocks and 50,000 characters, with the cells of any table in 'tables'. 'complete_document' is true only when the whole document was returned. When 'next_offset' is set, call again with 'continuation' to read the next page; if the document changed in between, the call is refused as Stale and the read must restart. Headers, footers, footnotes, frames and comments are not included.

offset.description: 1-based block (paragraph or table) to start at; prefer continuation

continuation.description: The previous page's continuation; refused as Stale if the document changed since

name: writer_insert_text
description: Insert bounded text at the start or end of an explicitly bound Writer document as one undo step. Set as_paragraph to true to add the text as its own new paragraph (a real paragraph break, in the same undo step); newlines inside the text then start further paragraphs.

name: writer_insert_paragraphs
description: Insert 1-50 paragraphs, each with its own optional paragraph style, at the start, the end, or after one paragraph (by number, with its full text as expected_text so a moved paragraph is refused as Stale). Every style is checked before anything is written; an unknown style changes nothing. A paragraph without a style keeps the style it inherits from its neighbour. All paragraphs are ONE undo step. Returns the new paragraph numbers, their styles as read back, and 'verified'.

name: impress_list_slides
description: List bounded slide titles and text summaries from an explicitly bound Impress document.

name: libreoffice_undo
description: Undo the most recent Hermes change(s) in an explicitly bound LibreOffice document (Calc, Writer or Impress), newest first, one bridge undo per step. Undoes only steps titled 'Hermes: ...', never the user's own edits; stops at the first step that is refused or uncertain and reports which steps were undone. The document is brought to the front first because LibreOffice applies undo through the focused window.

name: calc_rename_sheet
description: Rename a Calc sheet; an existing name is rejected. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_copy_sheet
description: Copy a Calc sheet to a new sheet at the end of the same spreadsheet. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_delete_sheet
description: Delete a Calc sheet. The only sheet of a spreadsheet cannot be deleted. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_find_replace
description: Find and replace text in the cells of one Calc sheet. whole_cell matches entire cell contents only. Returns the number of cells replaced. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_autofill
description: Fill a Calc range down or right from its first source_count rows or columns, continuing formulas and series as LibreOffice's fill handle does. address includes the source cells. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_range_stats
description: Compute count, numericCount, sum, average, min, max and blankCount for a Calc range (10,000 cells max). Read-only.

name: calc_add_comment
description: Add a comment to one Calc cell, replacing any comment already on it. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: calc_get_comments
description: List the comments on one Calc sheet with their cells (500 max). Read-only.

name: calc_clear_comments
description: Delete all comments in a Calc range; cell contents are left alone. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: writer_get_structure
description: List the blocks of a Writer document with their number, paragraph style, outline level and a short preview (500 per page). Tables appear as type 'table' with their name, size and cell count. Use 'continuation' to read the next page; a changed document is refused as Stale. Read-only.

offset.description: 1-based block (paragraph or table) to start at; prefer continuation

continuation.description: The previous page's continuation; refused as Stale if the document changed since

name: writer_get_table
description: Read the cells of one table in a Writer document's body, by its name or its block number from writer_get_structure: up to 2,000 cells per call in row order, 2,000 characters per cell. Use 'next_cell_offset' as cell_offset for more. Read-only.

name: writer_set_paragraph_style
description: Apply an existing paragraph style to one paragraph by its number from writer_get_structure. Give the style name as LibreOffice shows it (for example 'Heading 1', 'Body Text', 'Default Paragraph Style') or its internal name as writer_get_structure reports it ('Standard', 'Text body'); Word names such as 'Heading1' or 'Normal' are refused. expected_text, when given, must equal the paragraph's full text or the call is refused as Stale. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: writer_find_replace
description: Find and replace text throughout a Writer document. Returns the number of replacements. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: writer_apply_edits
description: Apply up to 50 exact, literal text edits as ONE undo step, all or nothing. Every edit is located before anything changes: if any 'find' is missing, appears more than once without an 'occurrence' (1-based, in the order LibreOffice finds it), or overlaps another edit's match, the whole batch is refused and nothing changes. 'match_case' defaults to true. Pass writer_get_text's 'fingerprint' as if_match to refuse a document that changed since it was read. The replacement takes the formatting of the first replaced character. Use writer_find_replace only when every match should change.

name: writer_get_selection
description: Read the text currently selected in a Writer document's window. Read-only.

name: writer_replace_selection
description: Replace the single current selection of a Writer document with text (or insert at the cursor when nothing is selected). expected_text must equal the selection as last read, or the call is refused as Stale. One undo step; the result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded it.

name: writer_format_selection
description: Apply character formatting to the single text selection in a Writer document: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font_name, font_size (points), color and highlight (#RRGGBB, or 'none' to clear the highlight). expected_text must equal the selection as last read or the call is refused as Stale. One undo step. Returns the formatting before and after, as read back, and 'verified'.

expected_text.description: the selection exactly as writer_get_selection returned it

name: writer_get_comments
description: List the comments in a Writer document with author, text and the text each one is anchored to (500 max). Read-only.

name: writer_add_comment
description: Add a review comment anchored to the single text selection in a Writer document; the selected text itself is kept. expected_text must equal the selection as last read or the call is refused as Stale. author defaults to 'Hermes'. One undo step; returns the comment as read back and 'verified'.

expected_text.description: the selection exactly as writer_get_selection returned it

name: impress_get_slide
description: Read one Impress slide: its layout number, size, and every shape with its number, type, placeholder role (title or body), text, position and size in centimetres. Read-only.

name: impress_create_slide
description: Create an Impress slide after after_slide (default: at the end) with a layout (title, title_content, title_only or blank) and optional title and body text placed in the layout's placeholders. The result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded an undo step; if it is false, remove the slide with impress_delete_slide instead of undo.

name: impress_delete_slide
description: Delete one Impress slide by number. The only slide of a presentation cannot be deleted. Check the result's 'undoable': if it is false the deletion cannot be undone.

name: impress_set_shape_text
description: Replace the whole text of one shape on an Impress slide. Give either shape (a number from impress_get_slide) or placeholder (title or body). The result includes previous_text and 'undoable'.

name: impress_add_text_box
description: Add a text box to an Impress slide at a position and size in centimetres (defaults: x 2, y 4, width 12, height 2). The result's 'undoable' says whether LibreOffice recorded an undo step.

name: impress_find_replace
description: Find and replace text in the shapes of one Impress slide, or of every slide when slide is omitted. Returns the number of replacements and 'undoable'.

name: impress_set_slide_layout
description: Change the layout of an existing Impress slide: title, title_content, title_two_content, title_only or blank. Placeholders that already hold text are kept even when the new layout has no slot for them, so no text is lost; the result lists the slide's shapes afterwards and 'text_preserved'. One bridge undo step that restores the previous layout.

expected_title.description: the slide's title text as last read; if given and different, the call is refused as Stale

name: impress_format_text
description: Format all the text in one shape of an Impress slide (by shape number or placeholder title/body): bold, italic, underline, font_name, font_size (points), color (#RRGGBB). Refused when a property to change is mixed inside the shape, because undo could not restore it exactly. One bridge undo step that restores the previous formatting.

expected_text.description: the shape's full text as last read with impress_get_slide; if given and different, the call is refused as Stale

expected_title.description: the slide's title text as last read; if given and different, the call is refused as Stale

name: impress_add_shape
description: Add a basic shape to an Impress slide: rectangle, rounded_rectangle, ellipse or line, at a position and size in centimetres (a line runs from x/y by width/height), with optional fill_color, line_color (#RRGGBB) and text (not for lines). One bridge undo step that removes it.

expected_title.description: the slide's title text as last read; if given and different, the call is refused as Stale

name: impress_get_current_slide
description: Read which slide the user is on in an Impress document's window, and the slides selected in the slide sorter when it is showing (otherwise just the current slide). Refused when the document has several windows. Read-only; read the slides with impress_get_slide.

name: impress_list_layouts
description: List the slide layouts the plugin can create or switch to (with their placeholders), the deck's master slides with the slides using each, and each slide's current layout. Read-only.
